title: Stop ignoring all dotted files: ignore only VCS folders, scope IDE/tool folders as build-and-deployment
target_unit: addIgnoreConventions() (150 LOC, very high) and addBuildAndDeploymentConventions() in ScopingConventions (file of 514 LOC, high risk)
notes: The reference commit ("scoping bug fix") removes the blanket "Hidden files" ignore rule, narrows the hidden-directory ignore rule to .git/.svn/.hg/.bzr, adds a build-and-deployment rule (.*/)?[.](idea|vscode|vs|gradle|mvn|settings|metadata|circleci)/.* and drops the .*/dependencies/.* ignore rule. In between, the real history had replaced the snapshot's single rule .*/[.][a-zA-Z0-9_]+.* ("Hidden files and folders") with a two-rule version (hidden files with a CI exemption + a VCS/IDE directory list), so the diff does not apply; the end state was re-derived against the snapshot: the snapshot's rule is replaced by the VCS rule, the build-and-deployment rule is added, the dependencies rule removed (+3/-2 in ScopingConventions). The commit's unrelated files-explorer.html change (removing two history links) is not part of the task. The acceptance test (7 cases, Convention.pathMatches over getIgnoredFilesConventions/getBuildAndDeploymentFilesConventions) covers ordinary sources, plain dotfiles and CI dotfiles kept, source under an incidental dotted folder kept, VCS folders ignored at every depth (incl. a root-level .git/config), the 8 IDE/tool folders not ignored and in build-and-deployment, a dependencies folder kept, and .yarn releases/plugins still ignored. A before: compiles and fails with assertion failures (5 of 7). A after: passes; mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer -am test green (337 tests, 0 failures, 3 skipped).
